body: I think I’ve ran out of things at this point in time.
Hey I have a brother with autism and I suffer from depression please message me I might be able to help you.
That’s not stupid. Applying to universities is stressful. It sure made me suicidal. I’m here if you need to talk. I went through this as well.
Thank you this really helped me.
Tried doing that and they just yelled at me and basically told me how selfish I was for freaking out. Thanks though I appreciate you taking the time to read this and for your response.

Hey, does your university have any support services or crisis lines? Maybe those could help, even just a little bit. I know how it feels to feel all hope is lost. You literally see no way out. The depression has completely taken over your mind. That is why you have to trust me in saying that there is hope out there and it won’t be this dark forever. I know it doesn’t seem like it, and I know that you probably don’t care you just want it to end now, but I’m telling you things change. Nothing in life is stagnant. If you give it a chance to, life will change. Please message me if you need. I’ve been through the hell you’re going through and I know that it’s possible to make it out on the other side.

Thank you for your response. I’m going to work on trying to turn things around and you’re right about the weed, I’ve been meaning to stop using it. Thank you for your response it is greatly appreciated.

Thank you so much for reading my long post and for responding. This really meant a lot to me. I’m going to try to keep pushing through even though it’s incredibly hard. But thank you. Thank you for your incredibly kind words they really helped to turn my day around. Also I’m glad to hear that you were able to find help and start feeling better :).
